title: Template:TeamShow/doc
wikitext:
;|player1= 
:Name for player 1.
;|flag1= 
:Flag for player1.
Supports up to 10 players.

==Example==
This code:
 <nowiki>
{{Team4on4|team=020|teamflag=se|player1=raket|flag1=se|player2=shaka|flag2=se|player3=greco|flag3=se|player4=rkd|flag4=se|player5=z0det|flag5=se}}</nowiki>
Returns this:
:{{Team4on4|team=020|teamflag=se|player1=raket|flag1=se|player2=shaka|flag2=se|player3=greco|flag3=se|player4=rkd|flag4=se|player5=z0det|flag5=se}}

==Example with {{abbr|abbreviation|Hover for explanation}}==
This code:
 <nowiki>
{{Team4on4|team={{abbr|Suddendeath|SD }}|teamflag=se|player1=bps|flag1=se|player2=carapace|flag2=se|player3=rio|flag3=se|player4=Rikoll|flag4=no}}</nowiki>
Returns this:
:{{Team4on4|team={{abbr|Suddendeath|SD }}|teamflag=se|player1=bps|flag1=se|player2=carapace|flag2=se|player3=rio|flag3=se|player4=Rikoll|flag4=no}}
